The desk-asana task view now lists a task's subtasks, opens them in place and walks back out, and sets the description, subtasks and comments apart.

- A task's subtasks are listed under its description. Click one to open it in the same pane; the pane scrolls to the top of the new task
- A subtask shows `↑ parent` above its title to open its parent. `← Previous task` (`b`, also at the bottom) goes back one task at a time and then to the list, bringing the subtask you came out of back into view
- The description, subtasks and comments each start under a full-width `── Comments 4 ───` style rule, comment authors are marked `● name`, and each comment's text is indented under its author, so comments no longer read as part of the description
- Up to 50 subtasks are listed; past that the pane says how many more there are to see on Asana
- On the Asana v2 server subtasks come by name only, so whether one is done shows once you open it; the claude.ai connector marks done subtasks with `✓`
- desk-look, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.72.0 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
